verdict.rationale: Edge and serverless functions are a fair question for a cloud platform like Railway, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions serverless or edge functions, a Node.js runtime, or npm package compatibility. Generic repo-based deployment and the line "run your application closer to where your users are" describe regional app hosting, which is adjacent rather than the story's function-runtime capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset
